title: Questionnaires and conversations
intro: Each questionnaire answers one question. Beforehand you see what it is for, how long it takes and who sees the result.

venture.title: For this venture
venture.lead: Applies to one venture and one period.

deepening.title: To go deeper
deepening.lead: Optional. Nothing here is missing from your profile.

team.title: With the team
team.lead: In pairs or together – in the team area.

noVenture: Questionnaires about a venture need a venture. It is created as soon as you invite someone or start a comparison.

setup.title: Founder Setup
setup.text: 23 topics you agree in writing. Every comparison ends here.

commitment.title: Commitment Lab
commitment.text: What do you expect from each other when it gets serious? In pairs.

exercises.title: Practise collaboration
exercises.text: Read My Mind and Founder in the Wild: small exercises for pairs.

purpose.label: Purpose
purpose.text: Make expectations and ways of working visible – not judge right or wrong.

not.label: What it is not
not.text: Not a personality test, no score, no match percentage, no types.

method.label: Method
method.text: Fixed questions and answer formats; only identical versions are compared.

privacy.label: Who sees what
privacy.text: Only you – until you share. In the team comparison only when everyone has shared.

flow.noCounts: No percentages, no counters. You can go back and change answers at any time.

limits.title: Limits
limits.text: What is out of the question for you. Sensitive – so later, and only if you want it.

start.workstyleLead: The start for everything else – your team comparison needs it too. Nothing is scored, and only you see your answers until you share them.
